name: Synoptic Chart
desc: A surface weather analysis redrawing itself forever: depressions are born in the west, deepen, throw cold and warm fronts that occlude as they age, and fill as they run off the east margin, while the isobars knot around them, rain shading sweeps the warm sector and every station plots its own wind barb across the pressure gradient.

density.doc: how many pressure systems share the chart at once

speed.doc: rate multiplier for advection and the analysis clock

fronts.doc: frontal linework and pip weight (0 = isobars only)

stations.doc: how many station models are plotted

hue.doc: paper + map hue (offset from the style anchor)

style.doc: aesthetic: hand-inked buff analysis chart / dark backlit plotting-table glass with luminous isobars / white-on-cyanotype drafting print / false-colour isotherm plate

act.doc: multi-minute programme: a steady procession of Atlantic lows / a stalled blocking high with everything crawling / explosive cyclogenesis, deep systems racing through
